description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogModel class within the OrangeHRM performance API module. The class represents a data model for performance tracker logs, including properties like ID, log details, comments, achievement, timestamps, and reviewer information. It implements serialization and permission traits, and provides a toArray method to output the model's data with access control considerations.
